001: I need to find a hotel for next week.
What kind of accommodation do you prefer? A hotel in the center or something quieter?
I prefer something central so I can walk everywhere.
Then I recommend the Hotel Central, it's very well located.
Do they have rooms available for Thursday?
Yes, I think so. We can call right now to confirm.
002: Could you tell me about the price of the double room?
Of course, the double room costs eighty euros per night with breakfast included.
And is breakfast a buffet or is it served at the table?
It's a buffet, and they have a wide variety of products.
That seems like a good price. Is the tax included?
Yes, the tax is included in the price I gave you.
003: I saw an ad for a very nice vacation apartment.
Where is it? Downtown or on the outskirts?
It's near the beach, about a ten-minute walk.
How nice! And what services does it include?
It has wifi, air conditioning, and a small equipped kitchen.
Sounds perfect for spending a few relaxing days.
004: I wanted to make a reservation for two nights, please.
Very well, what dates would the reservation be for?
It would be for Friday and Saturday of next week.
Alright. Would you prefer a room with a sea view?
Yes, if possible, I would love to have a sea view.
Perfect, I'll note down a room with a view. May I have your name?
005: I just arrived at the hotel and I have a reservation under the name Laura.
Welcome, Miss Laura. Let me look up your reservation in the system.
Could you give me a quiet room, away from the elevator?
Yes, of course. I'll give you a room at the end of the hallway.
Thank you very much. What time is breakfast served?
Breakfast is served from seven until ten thirty.
006: Do you have any special offers for one-week stays?
Yes, if you stay seven nights, we give you a ten percent discount.
That interests me! And can I cancel the reservation at no cost?
You can cancel for free up to forty-eight hours before arrival.
That seems like a very reasonable condition.
So, shall I prepare the reservation with that offer?
007: I booked a room online, but I haven't received the confirmation.
Don't worry, let me check with your name.
My name is Javier García. The reservation was for tonight.
Yes, I see it here. Your room has been ready since two in the afternoon.
What a relief! I thought the reservation had been lost.
No, don't worry, everything is in order. Do you need help with your luggage?
008: Do you recommend any charming accommodation in the old town?
I suggest a country house that is very nicely decorated and very cozy.
And does it have parking? Because I'm going by car.
Yes, it has free private parking for guests.
That's a big advantage. Is it far from the center?
No, it's about a five-minute walk from the main square.
009: Could you move me to a brighter room?
Let me see what options I have available right now.
The current room is a bit dark and I don't feel comfortable.
I understand. I have a room on the third floor with a lot of natural light.
And does it have the same price as the one I have now?
Yes, the price is the same. I'll get you the new key right now.
010: What time do I have to leave the room on the day of checkout?
Checkout is at twelve noon, but you can leave your luggage in the luggage room.
Perfect, that way I can take advantage of the morning to go for a walk.
Very good idea. Would you like me to order a taxi for that time?
Yes, please, that would be a big help.
Alright, I'll order a taxi for twelve thirty.
